envs.name: abnttblr
envs.doc: An additional environment abnttblr, tallabnttblr, and longabnttblr are wrapper to tblr, talltblr, and longtblr that apply abnt theme automatically and permit to set table font using \SetAbntTblrFont{} provided here.
